verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਧਿਆਨ ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰ ਹੈ।
verses.translit_en: gur moorat kar dhiaan sadhaa hajoor hai|

en.bdb: Concentrate upon the Guru-word considering it as the figure of the Guru who is always with you.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਦੂਰ ਹੈ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh sabadh giaan neR na dhoor hai|

en.bdb: Due to the knowledge of the Word, the gurmukh finds the Lord always near and not far off.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੁਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਤੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ਕਰਮ ਅੰਕੂਰ ਹੈ।
verses.translit_en: purab likhat neesaan karam a(n)koor hai|

en.bdb: But the seed of karmas sprouts according to the previous karmas.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ਸੇਵਕ ਸੂਰ ਹੈ।
verses.translit_en: gur sevaa paradhaan sevak soor hai|

en.bdb: The valiant servant becomes leader in doing service to the Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਸਦ ਭਰਪੂਰ ਹੈ।
verses.translit_en: pooran param nidhaan sadh bharapoor hai|

en.bdb: God, the supreme store house is always full and omnipresent.
His glory shines forth in the holy congregation of the saints.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਲਖ ਸਸੀਅਰ ਭਾਨੁ ਕਿਰਣਿ ਠਰੂਰ ਹੈ।
verses.translit_en: lakh lakh saseear bhaan kiran Tharoor hai|

en.bdb: The brightness of myriads of moons and suns is subdued before the light of the holy congregation.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਲਖ ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਣਿ ਕੀਰਤਨ ਚੂਰ ਹੈ।
verses.translit_en: lakh lakh bedh puraan keeratan choor hai|

en.bdb: Millions of Vedas and Puranas are insignificant before the praises of the Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਚਰਣਾ ਧੂਰ ਹੈ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit_en: bhagat vachhal paravaan charanaa dhoor hai ||10||

en.bdb: The dust of the feet of the beloved of the Lord is dear to the gurmukh.
